BAIL APPLICATION
[Court]
[parties]
Under Section 480 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (BNSS).

FACTS
[F1] The applicant has no antecedents.
[F2] The applicant has been in custody since the arrest.

GROUNDS
The applicant states that he has no antecedents [F1].

The applicant states that he has been in custody since the arrest [F2].

Notes for the lawyer
- Check the period of custody.
- 1 fact(s) were not marked as the applicant's side and were not used.

PRAYER
To be completed by counsel. This draft gives grounds only; no relief is drafted.
